subject: ECONOMICS
pageTitle: Supply and Demand Shifts: Price and Quantity
description: See how shifts in demand and supply change equilibrium price and quantity, and avoid mixing up a shift with a move along the curve.
caption: Supply and demand shifts in 7 swipes: what happens to price and quantity, with two examples and the shift vs movement trap. Free Economics study guide at precisstudy.com/economics (no sign-up).

slides.title: SUPPLY AND DEMAND: WHAT HAPPENS TO PRICE?
DEMAND SHIFTS
lines: Demand up: price up, quantity up
Demand down: price down, quantity down
slides.note: Demand moves price and quantity the same way.

slides.title: SUPPLY SHIFTS
lines: Supply up: price down, quantity up
Supply down: price up, quantity down
slides.note: Supply moves price and quantity in opposite ways.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1
slides.problem: A new trend makes sneakers more popular. What happens?
steps: More people want sneakers at every price

slides.title: EXAMPLE 2
slides.problem: A better machine makes shoes cheaper to produce. What happens?
steps: Producers can sell more at every price

slides.title: WATCH OUT
slides.wrong: A price change shifts the demand curve
points: A price change moves along the curve. It does not shift it.
Shifts come from income, tastes, costs, technology and expectations.
